title: President Kovind receives first copy of "Fulfilling Bapu's Dreams - PM's Tribute to Gandhiji"
description: Follow The President of India: ►Twitter: https://twitter.com/rashtrapatibhvn ►Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/PresidentOfIndia/ ►Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/presidentofindia/ ►Subscribe to channel: https://www.youtube.com/presidentofindia ►Website: http://presidentofindia.nic.in/

asr.full_text: Dear Deviyo and Sahajiyano, The book on which the inauguration was announced is titled Fulfilling Bapu's Deems. Prime Minister Modi's Tribute to Gandhi Ji. The main person of the inaugurations was This is the main presenter in a collection of this book. He is the Sadguru Jaggi Vasudev Ji. The founder of Sulabh International. Dr. Vindeshwar Pathak Ji Dear guests of this event and also dear devotees. Brahma Netitio- Deviyoar Sajjuno The songs that we listened to are a very dear one of father. It's called Baisho' Jan . And sometimes, these Baisho' words are a symbol of purity. It's symbol of purity. It is a symbol of purity. And if we see it from a behavioral point of view, the road travelers or the people who eat food abroad, a in many places, they eat Baisalna Dhaba. In Baisalna dhaba, people think that this is really a pure vegetarian. They think this is a purification. And Gandhiji didn't do it in this context of the time in purpose but this very dear sake of purpose, but the well-known song of his was this one song of his – Raghu-Pati, Raghavo, Raja-Ram. And I feel that through the two songs, he not only freed the country and the whole world from materialism and materialism, It is a road to attain physical liberation. This song has an inspiration across these two songs. I'm really moved to achieve the first chapter in this book. This book is connected with dad's dreams. The author also wrote one of the books, which was titled Bharaat . You may remember that book, which is also affiliated to this very Sher-Chak.. ..what Gandhi had said in that connection is this, I would like to quote that.. If I work for such a country which will also be felt by the poorest people.. ..as like a country where their. Their voice is important for the creation of these. I would like to fight for an India that has no discrimination of higher and lesser classes. In that, women will have the same rights as men have. In his book Gandhiji mentioned how to clean villages In the book, Gandhi expressed his thoughts on the problems related to the cleanliness, health, culture and other subjects. It is the responsibility of every Indian. This is an effort Bapu took a hundred years ago to educate all of us so that we can do our own work of teaching. During the era of freedom, Swakshita became a successful social experiment and in its success, Dr. Bindeshwar Pathak has been an extremely important member of this community. ...of Bindeshwar that they should be able to improve the local standards. He helped his generation and many of his class... ...lead the same and went beyond the thoughts associated... ...with politics but moved them towards the fields of organization and management of the land... ...and also worked in the field of land-restoration... ...in those days when the nature of living was not given too much importance... ...Dr. Pathak created his organisation Solab International... ...to work in the field of environment and nature... ...due to which today, it-deserved in the international sphere. Jaggi Vasudevji is a great beneficiary of his efforts in preserving the ethical and spiritual reenactment and practical resources in this world. By explaining the unbroken relationships of nature and mankind, they are moving forward the effort that is done by the Green Hands and One Sinh, Their rally for reverse campaign aroused a public awareness, which will have a profound impact on water conservation In contrast, it has opened the universal awareness of all beings. This awareness would have an impact on water management. Nature's protection is the first step in spirituality. This is evident in their efforts. By shaping cleanliness, the national human movement On 50th D日 , the PM Modi is encouraging a national movement for the preservation of health in the country. On 70th Of May a national movement and international public movement were held in the country, in favour of the cleanliness of the country. Giving the responsibility to the peace-keeping industry of the country,ement against sovereignty with the identity of country. He has made it clear through this mission's actions that by achieving all the goals of Swaksha Bharat Mission itself we can express sincere true faith in the National Father Gandhiji Everyone believes that by thinking openly several diseases spread In the eyes of one estimation Due to such diseases Daily around one thousand children die in one year and effect on children's physical and mental development. This disease affects the ability of the poor people to earn so it is said to be the right thing to do for cleanliness even to serve the poor. working to save people is same as serving poor people. With regard to fulfilling father's dream, the efforts and principles of Prime Minister Narendra Modi are effective towards the national development In those aspects, we could find this book today. Today I am going to explain a book where India's development behind the change after independence was described and highlighted in the book. This section covers the importance of people's participation in the national development process, Connecting people from a different political side Formulating it as a movement towards the people Providing a core focus, to the needs, of ordinary citizens In practice and system And to establish political ideals in popular life with full commitment In this aspect of development Mahatma Gandhi's thoughts and actions are prominent are based on Mahatma Gandhi's thoughts and practice and approach Due to a lack of patience in the attempts to develop The lowest level of the social economic pyramid have now been linked to the main pillar of the economic system Women and daughters are noticing changes in their usual daily life. Today the results of the Suksh Bharat campaign are helping the girls in the schools of village and town to continue their education. Through Suksh-Aadhabhaan, a large number of issuesouched issues were being fixed. We all know about which I have gone into detail. One such issue has become a common issue in the Indian community or within the social tradition, and that is that when we for the sake of marriage were looking for a husband for our daughter or sister to marry, first priority was that the son should be educated and is an employed person. Today in that there is one condition added for this other thing. they have joined one more condition They have joined that if they have a housewife in the in-law's house then only they will be married We saw that by so many ways that the daughters who have got married but have left after leaving the mandap or else there is a housewife And then they came to know that they have no housewife with him she went home after that or when the parents went home and they found out that there is no toilet in our home then he said he will not go home until the toilet is not made taking a new perspective and our daughters see it from that idea how much awareness is coming with their daughters see from that fantasy how much awareness we get from that awareness, it was said the daughters of India will never rebel but not rebel but show awareness for a prosperous country being clean is a fundamental condition the PM With respect to a free nation, to promote purity is the basic requirement. The Prime Minister has presented purity as the highest priority and has given it the form of a People's Movement. The Prime Minister's efforts to connect the ideals of National President Mahatma Gandhi with national development, on a grand scale, on a cultural scale, which was developed and published by Bhadranjit Ji's book of his. I am confident that in order to refute this change this book should be written in an open way. By Ghandi Jee, he said that he wants to see India as independent and powerful. Our country is moving forward with a new energy at the direction of fulfilling the dream of seeing India in the form of a powerful country. In some areas such as productivity, vulnerability, welfare of women are the places where he had mentioned about the path taken by Bapu.. and helps in preventing, preventative and humanitarian problems in a wide range of issues. I congratulate the entire team of BlueCraft digital Foundation , who helped me write and publish this book. I wish you all both success for your work. Thank you very much. Congratulations to the entire team of A.B.G Foundation And best wishes for the success of this book Thanks and Jai Hind
